body:
Findings of the three-way review of B2 (T-292) and T-299 on main, before anything is released. All
reproduced by the reviewers unless marked "by reading". Fix in one pass; the decisions in the
notes of T-292 stand.

## Login and accounts (P2)

1. `AccountGone.TO_START` (ui/Nav.kt) navigates to `Routes.LOGIN_PATTERN` literally, so after
   removing or deleting the last account the start screen's server field reads "{serverUrl}".
   Navigate to `Routes.login(LoginMode.START)`; test the path.
2. An invite tapped on a phone with no account leaves [login(start), list] on the back stack:
   redeem pops itself and pushes a second login entry; success pops only the top one. Back from
   the joined list opens the login form. In START mode pop to the graph root on success (3.1.0
   used popUpTo(LOGIN) + launchSingleTop).
3. Re-sign-in accepts another account's credentials: B signed in from A's "Sign in again" form
   is added as a new row, A stays signed out with its unpushed rows, nothing is said. Refuse it:
   `AuthRepository.login` gets an `expect` argument (START: none; ADD: refuse when the matched
   row is already signed in, BEFORE touching its token/cursor/flags — today the duplicate check in
   LoginViewModel runs after login() has replaced them, orphaning the old server session; RESIGNIN(rowId):
   the response must match that row's accountId, else revoke the new token on the unbound
   client and throw `WrongAccountException` → "These are another account's credentials."). The
   view model only maps exceptions to messages.
4. A migrated 3.1.0 row with accountId == null (lists with no recorded owner) can never be
   re-activated: `registry.find(url, accountId)` never matches null, so every sign-in from its
   banner adds a new row and the lists appear twice. In RESIGNIN for such a row, adopt it: set
   accountId/email from the response. Fix the Migration8To9 KDoc ("the next login replaces it" is
   no longer true).
5. `keepOtherAccounts` still defaults to false and `removeOtherAccounts`/the wipe path has no
   caller: delete both; login always keeps the other accounts (T-260's "wipe a stranger's mirror"
   is superseded by accounts side by side).
6. The Account screen of a signed-out account offers every server action (sessions load fails
   at once; "delete on server" gets a 401 and says "password incorrect"). Show the re-sign-in
   banner there and hide the server-bound sections while signed out.
7. Registration check in ADD mode asks the last typed server, not the URL an invite prefilled.
   Use the form's current URL once the user confirmed it (the T-287 rule: never before).

## Invite links (P2)

8. Server: `routes/landing.py:_intent_url` builds `intent://{host}/invite/{token}` and drops the
   mount path, so on p23q.org/shopping a link opened through the landing page matches no account
   and offers "Add account" for the wrong server; with prod at the root and stage under /stage, a
   stage link lands in prod. Fix on the server: include base_url's path. No client-side host
   fallback (the maintainer's rule: never match by host alone). Server test. wire-contract/README
   sentence if the landing page is described there.
9. AndroidManifest `pathPattern="/.*/invite/.*"` does not backtrack: only 0- and 1-segment mount
   paths resolve to the app; the p2/p3 deep-link patterns in Nav.kt can never fire. Add
   `/.*/.*/invite/.*` and `/.*/.*/.*/invite/.*`; a Robolectric test resolving each depth through
   PackageManager (InviteDeepLinkTest only calls handleDeepLink).
10. A parked invite (PendingInviteHolder) outlives a login the user backed out of and takes over
    the next unrelated login (a re-sign-in resumes a stale invite for another server; a bare token
    parked for a signed-out account gets redeemed on a later login). Clear the stash when the
    login form is left without success, and consume it only for the mode/account/server it was
    parked for.
11. After an "Add account" made for a link, `startDestinationAfterLogin` passes
    `invite.accountId` (null), so the redeem matches the link's prefix again; if the user
    corrected the prefilled URL, it loops back to "already added". Resume with the id `login()`
    returned.
12. The Join-a-list dialog (RedeemDialog) sends the user straight back to the login form when
    reopened: `needsLogin` (and `redeemedListId`) are never reset. Reset once acted on, like
    `joinedListOpened()`.
13. `ListPropsViewModel.revokeInvite` (and loadMembers/sendInvite, `OverviewViewModel.joinInvite`)
    call `ListAccounts.api()`, which throws IllegalStateException when the list row or its account
    is gone; only ApiException/IOException are caught → crash. Make `api()` return null (rename
    `apiOrNull` semantics into it) and treat null as "list gone" everywhere; test the revoke path.

## P3, same pass

14. Subtitle (ListTitleViewModel) and notification sub-text show only the email; the label is
    email + server URL (prod and stage share an email). Show "email · host/path".
15. A section's invites do not appear after its account re-signs in or is added until
    pull-to-refresh (the accounts collector only removes). Re-fetch when an account turns signedIn.
16. A pasted message "Join my list: https://…/invite/T" sends everything before /invite/ as the
    URL. Extract the first https URL from the pasted text before matching; a bare token stays a
    bare token.
17. lastOpenedListId is not set when a list is opened from a redeem, a notification or a
    duplication; the New-list picker default ignores them. Set it wherever a list screen opens
    (the LIST composable is the one place).
18. Server admin with several admin accounts: only the first is reachable from the drawer and
    AdminScreen never names its server. Add a "Server admin" row on each admin account's Account
    screen; AdminScreen's app bar shows the server host.
19. A migrated row's locked re-sign-in URL is 3.1.0's last typed URL, which may not be the
    session's server: when the row has no accountId, leave the URL editable.
20. The removal dialog's copy hint describes something the app cannot do yet; B4 (T-294) makes it
    true. Leave the string; note on T-294 that its wording must name the local area once B3 exists.

## Data layer, seams and docs (from the third review)

21. Dead auth API from the removed sign-out: `AuthRepository.logout`, `clearLocalSession`,
    `removeOtherAccounts`, the `keepOtherAccounts=false` path, `AccountSessions.forcedLogout`
    (emitted, never collected), `RecordingAuthRepository.loggedOut/clearedLocally`, and the three
    T-260 tests that only exercise the dead path. Delete them; the 401 handling stays in
    `AccountSessions.onUnauthorized` (token deleted, row signed out). KDoc in AccountSessions and
    the AuthRepository bullet in core/README.md follow.
22. `AuthRepository.login`'s "Best-effort; the next Settings visit reads it again" is false: nothing
    reads default_currency again, and the Account screen then saves initials with currency "" →
    422 invalid_currency. `AccountViewModel.loadInitials` takes the currency from the same
    /settings response and writes it to the row.
23. SyncEngine.kt: two KDoc blocks stacked on `syncAccount` (merge them); a comment still says
    dirtyRows(). DatabaseModule.kt: the stub comment says "the first server account (the one the
    screens show)"; the SQL prefers a server account and falls back to a local one — say that, and
    test the local-only case.
24. SyncEngineTest "two accounts that share a list pull it into a row each" passes when the merge
    ignores the account (a stub satisfies every assertion): also assert mate's row name and
    !deleted.
25. Merge leftovers: unused imports in SettingsScreen.kt (nine), RootViewModelTest, AccountScreenTest,
    ExpenseClosingTest, OverviewViewModelTest, LoginViewModelTest, ListScreenTest, ListViewModelTest,
    ListPropsViewModelTest, RedeemDialogTest, RedeemScreenTest, RedeemViewModelTest, OverviewScreen,
    ExpenseListScreen; dead string `settings_msg_offline` (nine locales); the "Overview by account
    (T-292)" strings block sits above app_name — move it next to the other B2 block at the end.
26. The invite flow is written twice (OverviewViewModel.joinInvite and RedeemViewModel): one shared
    helper (redeem → syncJoined → localIdForServerId → offline fallback → error mapping).
27. AGENTS.md's parity exception names only the start/Accounts/Account screens; word it as
    everything that exists because the phone holds several accounts (overview sections, new-list
    picker, invite chooser, list subtitle, notification sub-text, per-account settings living on
    the Account screen).

## Decided, not a defect

An account logged out on 3.1.0 becomes a signed-out account beside any new one after the upgrade
(its unpushed rows kept, banner offers sign-in). That is the multi-account model and the
maintainer's "nothing automatic"; the previous person's data is removed only by removing the account.
title: B2 review follow-ups: login modes and re-sign-in, invite links (landing intent path, deep-link depth, parked invites), crashes on a gone list, dead sign-out API, seams
